steps.text: 这一趟带回来的东西在这里。点【一键置入】，或者双击、拖进右边的仓库。

texts.en: What you brought back is here. Press [Put all away], or double-click or drag things into the Warehouse on the right.

steps.text: 科技分两棵：数值树花金币和材料，机制树花见识。

texts.en: Tech has two trees: the stat tree costs gold and materials, the mechanics tree costs Insight.

steps.text: 后勤：集市用金币买卖，铁匠铺按配方打造。买不买随你。

texts.en: Logistics: buy and sell for gold at the Market, forge from recipes at the Smithy. Entirely optional.

steps.text: 书架：图鉴、对局记录、特殊道具和成就。

texts.en: Bookshelf: Collection, Run records, Keepsakes and Achievements.

steps.text: 想继续时，在出征页点【开始探索】开下一段。不急，先逛逛也行。

texts.en: When you're ready, press [Set out] on the Expedition page for the next part. No rush, look around first.
